name: pocp
about: POCP itself: node:test, zero dependencies. The bench's own repository is the default source.
setupNote: The full suite takes minutes per run, so the scratch copy's test script runs the unit tests (about 7s) and the engine-tests requirement is dropped. The other requirements, the config and the CI workflow are POCP's own. The base also gets a small fixture for the hollowed-helper scenario: src/bench/clamp.js, its test test/bench-clamp.test.js (in the test script), and the assertion helper it imports, lib/check.js, outside the test folders (from bench/tamper/fixtures/pocp/).
